calculate the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain regions in human, pig and mouse.
the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus
```{r}

```
```{r}

```

Human had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression
